# How many stock options can you exercise before AMT?

> Free ISO and AMT calculator. Enter your income and options to find how many incentive stock options you can exercise this year before the alternative minimum tax starts, and the AMT and cash needed if you exercise more. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
